results.title: Schema11 roundtrip preserves tasks, history, templates, rules, projects and settings
Removed recurrence retains its stored generation lock
Project and template attachments exclude inline data and transient URLs
Local-only holiday setting is excluded from cloud records
Backup merges disjoint IDs and identical records without duplication or mutation
Backup conflict must not silently overwrite completed history
Object-form template checklist must retain text instead of string coercion
Task projectResources must exclude inline bytes and transient URLs too
Completed current task defeats an older planned backup even with incoming choice
Completion history cannot be removed, edited or duplicated by merge or restore
Same ID equal content ignores key order; new tasks are added once
Different content is a conflict; selected ordinary edits retain unknown fields
Project stages, protected task IDs and attachment refs remain linked on conflict
Generated keys cannot add a second task ID or resurrect a durable lock
Attachment ID metadata conflicts cannot replace current file refs
Malformed JSON, missing collections, invalid schema, dates, IDs and history are refused
Dangling project, task and attachment refs and inline file bytes are refused before writing
Restore warns about removals but retains omitted completed tasks and unknown root fields
Cancel and stale review do not call snapshot, publish or persistence
Snapshot must be durable first; committed state equals reviewed result
Snapshot failure and changes during snapshot preparation abort before any data write
Write failure preserves memory and exposes recovery-required status without success
Restore needs separate confirmation and forged reviews are rejected
Actual import file picker previews differences and cancel changes nothing
Confirmed local import stores recovery first and failures display recovery-required
Successful merge matches preview and stale UI cannot apply an obsolete review
Recovery preparation cannot write a previous account snapshot into another account cache
MOCK cloud preview is read-only; approval saves exact result and preserves history
MOCK queued remote edits and account changes invalidate the reviewed baseline
MOCK codec field loss is surfaced as validation errors before any snapshot or write
MOCK partial cloud commit has no offline fallback, no publish and blocks further saves
MOCK import transactions compare remote create, update, delete and key-lock baselines before writes
MOCK durable generated-key locks and fresh plan verification prevent recurring-task resurrection
MOCK checklist-only import checks the parent task for a new remote completion
MOCK late unrelated remote changes are kept and reported as recovery-required
JSON preserves all IDs, Tasks legacy fields, history and locks without claiming originals
Manifest hashes match exact included bytes with Korean distinct paths
Missing original reports reason and cannot claim complete backup
Repeated file ID fetches once while preserving all references
ZIP rejects traversal, duplicate normalized paths and entry limits before reading
ZIP enforces single and aggregate size before buffer allocation
Cancellation and account change stop download preparation
Bounded media reader rejects unknown-length stream before unlimited buffering
Actual ZIP writer stores original bytes and UTF8 paths with correct CRC
Project, library, linked steps and task references participate in ZIP inventory
Chromium handover reports partial originals and JSON retains legacy references
